message.content:
I need to compute the precise average time-to-merge for 34 merged PRs from the cli/cli repository that were created in December 2024. I need exact timestamps (not just dates) to compute this accurately.

Use WebFetch to access individual PR API endpoints to get the exact `created_at` and `merged_at` timestamps. The GitHub API for individual PRs should work without auth for public repos (at least some requests before rate limiting).

Here are the 34 merged PR numbers: 9985, 9992, 9999, 10006, 10009, 10012, 10016, 10019, 10020, 10025, 10026, 10043, 10044, 10048, 10051, 10055, 10056, 10070, 10074, 10078, 10094, 10102, 10104, 10110, 10112, 10116, 10121, 10124, 10135, 10139, 10143, 10145, 10151, 10154

Try fetching them from the GitHub API: https://api.github.com/repos/cli/cli/pulls/{number}

For each PR, extract the `created_at` and `merged_at` fields. Then compute:
1. For each PR: the time difference in days (as a float) between created_at and merged_at
2. The average of all those values, rounded to 1 decimal place

If the API rate limits you, try fetching them from the web pages instead (https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/{number}) and extract the timestamps from the page content.

If you still can't get exact timestamps, try using the GitHub Search API to get all 34 PRs in bulk:
https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=repo:cli/cli+is:pr+is:merged+created:2024-12-01..2024-12-31&per_page=100

Report the exact created_at and merged_at for every single PR, plus the computed average.
